name: iphone

frames.best_why: The handset is fully in view with no cursor covering the screen.

tagline: A tall phone frame holding a purple and blue wallpaper on its screen.
summary: An iPhone-shaped mockup drawn in SVG, with side buttons, a dark bezel, a pill cut-out at the top and a screen that wraps a photo or a looping video.
appearance: A tall rounded handset on black: a dark slate bezel around a nearly full-bleed screen, slim side buttons on the left edge and a short pill-shaped slot near the top of the display. The screen shows a soft purple-to-blue gradient.
behaviour: Static in the frames: nothing moves or responds. The phone keeps its tall proportions while scaling with its width, and a supplied video loops behind the bezel instead of the still image.
demo_content: A purple and blue abstract wallpaper filling the screen
search_phrases: phone frame for an app screenshot
show a screen inside a smartphone
device outline for a portfolio shot
handset graphic for a landing page
app store screenshot inside a phone
rounded phone body with side buttons
put a video inside a phone mockup
use_when: A mobile screenshot or product video should look like it is playing on a real handset.
avoid_when: Full-bleed hero art, where the bezel eats space, or when a specific handset model matters.
customise: Pass src or videoSrc for the screen; the frame follows light and dark themes, while the bezel shape and button placement are fixed in the SVG.
weight_why: One inline SVG plus a single image or video, with no scripted animation.

a11y.note: The screen image has empty alt and the frame has no title, so screen readers meet an unlabelled graphic.

issues: The side buttons are nearly the same tone as the bezel and barely read.
polish_why: Convincing handset silhouette and a clean screen; the dark bezel swallows the side buttons.
